svg.font-family: Poppins, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Where the parts go: fingerprint sensor at the door, camera on the classroom wall, Raspberry Pi in between
svg.desc: A teacher scans a finger on the sensor outside the classroom door, and the LCD above it shows the lecture. Inside, a camera above the board photographs all the students at random moments during the lecture. A Raspberry Pi in a box on the wall between them matches the faces and saves the attendance to MySQL, which the website shows to students and faculty.

g.text: Faculty scans a finger at the door
The finger tells which subject's lecture
starts. The LCD greets the teacher.
Photographs the whole class at random
moments in the lecture (6 per hour).
Matches every face and saves the
result to MySQL after each photo.
Leaving early shows up as absent.
